name: Shimla & Manali
tagline: Hill-station offsites within a night's drive of Delhi
intro: The classic North Indian hill circuit, and still one of the most cost-effective ways to get a Delhi team somewhere that feels genuinely away. Shimla suits conference-style programmes; Manali suits activity-led ones.
best_months: March to June, and September to November
best_season: March to June, and September to November
access: Roughly eight hours by road from Delhi to Shimla, or fly to Chandigarh and drive.
highlights: Reachable entirely by road, which removes air fares from the budget and makes an annual offsite repeatable.
Shimla's older hotels have real conference capacity; Manali is better for adventure and team activity days.
A combined itinerary gives you a working leg and an activity leg without a second flight.
planning_note: The road up is the whole risk. Landslides during the monsoon and snow in January can close it, and peak-season traffic can add hours. Build a buffer day and avoid promising a tight arrival time.
